changes.title: fix(lf): hold the crystal (HFXO) in reader mode
feat(lf): make T55xx password protection an explicit opt-in
CLI: T55xx write and clone commands read the tag back and say whether the write took
fix(lf): pause BLE advertising during LF reader commands
fix: resync the Viking decoder when it falls out of phase
feat(lf): Indala 64-bit read, emulate and T55xx clone
fix: fewer LF emulation burst gaps, emulation after a mode switch or type change, and slot type changes
PSK1 self-trim: PSK1 emulation (such as Indala and IDTECK) measures the reader's clock and matches its timing to it
fix: respond to a reader faster after waking from sleep
fix: start emulation before bluetooth on boot
fix: start the sleep timer after a VBUS wake-up with no USB power
fix: stay dark when static on the case wakes the device
USB animations play only while a computer is using the CU. On a charger the LEDs show the slot
The USB idle animation breathes the active slot's LED, dimmer
fix(lf): delay the first PSK1 frame after field detection like a tag power-up
Interactive LF emulation: Hitag 2 tags in password mode, with a timing mode for each slot, and a Hitag 2 reader
fix(lf): reject IND26 frames when the even parity fails
fix(cli): close the connection after --command so the CLI exits
fix: save a slot's LF data when another slot already holds the same data
fix(cli): load emv cards into the slot given with --slot
PSK1 self-trim starts on for a new or reset CU. A CU with saved settings keeps its own setting
A Hitag 2 slot times its answers by the reader's own carrier, measured as each field starts, unless the slot is set to another mode
